title: Review of c16's evoloop (IBDH): small-loop sweeps are clonal and carried by their own breeding, not by mutation inflow; they replicate on fresh seed 4 (at t~220k) but not on seed 6 within 200k, so waiting times are long and stochastic
summary: Ran labkit packs on fresh seeds 4 and 5 (300^2, 20k steps: 247/255 persistent splits, generation 28, merge/split 0.38) and c16's evo_track.py at 400^2 on fresh seeds 4 (400k steps) and 6 (200k), and re-ran c16's seed 2 (150k) to dissect a sweep. Two new scripts: origins.py traces every living loop of a kind back to the mutation event that founded its clade, and decompose.py splits each kind's change per window into own (on-kind) births, mutation inflow and deaths. In both observed sweeps (seed 2 at 77k, seed 4 at 220k) side 4 rises from ~1 to ~200 loops within 10k steps; 98% of its births in that window are on-kind (2781-4583 own vs 65-90 inflow), its own net rate is +0.14 to +0.23 per 1000 loop-steps while side 11's is -0.27 to -0.28, and 50-82% of the side-4 loops descend from one mutation event; side 3 then follows the same way (63-64% from one event). Before a viable small variant appears, off-size daughters are near-sterile (own birth rate 0.06-0.24 vs 1.4 for side 11), and on seed 6 none established in 200k steps, while side 12 rose to 44% on inflow, not on a higher own rate (-0.28 vs -0.18).

observations.I: rerun/seed4/sheet.png: discrete square sheathed loops with arms, 30-55 at a time
observations.D: rerun/seed4/lineage.png and seed5: 247 and 255 persistent splits, max generation 28, merge/split 0.38
observations.H: sweeps.png panel 1 (fresh seed 4): side 4 replaces side 11 at t~220-230k, then side 3 by t~270k and holds to 400k; origins.txt: 50% of side-4 loops at t=240k from one event (t=220240), 64% of side-3 loops at 260k from one event (t=235400); trk400_s4_decomp.json window 220-230k: side 4 own births 2781 vs inflow 90, own net +0.23 vs side 11 -0.27

seeds_run.result: pass: labkit pack; tracker sweep side 11 -> 4 -> 3 at t~220-270k
no small-kind sweep within 200k steps; side 11/12 alternate by inflow
c16's seed, re-run: sweep reproduced (side 4 at t~77k, side 3 at ~115-140k)

controls_run.H: not a neutral twin: per-window decomposition (decompose.py) of each kind's gain into own breeding vs mutation inflow, and clade-origin tracing (origins.py), on trk400_s4, trk_s6 and trk_c16s2; the alternative 'small kinds win by mutation pressure' predicts high inflow and many founding events, and the data show the opposite

verdicts.limitation: No identical-event neutral twin (none is constructible in this CA, size sets the replication time), so H rests on own-breeding vs inflow and clade origins. Parent attribution is c16's nearest-loop-within-40px rule, which can assign a daughter to a same-kind neighbour; clade shares are therefore approximate, but the own-vs-inflow counts do not depend on which same-kind parent is chosen. The fitness advantage of small loops coincides with a 3-4x rise in loop number (they pack denser), so 'selection' here includes a change of the carrying capacity. Sweeps need a rare viable variant: 2 of 3 tracker seeds swept, with waiting times 77k and 220k, and seed 6 did not sweep in 200k; '3 of 3 seeds' in the claim depends on run length. Kinds are hole sides read from the CA state; 0.05-0.09 conversions of living loops per off-kind birth (c16) were not re-measured. B (sheath) not checked: I did not re-run the sheath ablation. Large tracker JSONs (64 MB) are not included; decomp JSONs and origins.txt are.
